caption: The drawing depicts a circular shield decorated with feathers and an image on its surface. The shield's main area is yellow and features the depiction of a pink or red horse with a rider in yellow, adorned with blue, red, and yellow details. Large black and brown feathers, mostly shaded with hints of white and gray, are attached around the upper perimeter of the shield, with some blue and red cloth elements near where the feathers are affixed. Along the lower rim of the shield, there is a border with a pattern of green and pink triangular decorations surrounded by a band of green and dots of pink and yellow. At the top of the drawing, "RIO GRANDE PUEBLOS" is written in large, uppercase black letters, and “CASE – 45” is written in smaller text at the top right. Below the shield, the words “SHIELD 20 X 20 INS DECORATED HIDE–FEATHERS.” appear. The drawing is signed at the bottom by “C. CHARON 10/17/35” with all elements drawn in colored pencil on an off-white or tan background.
title: Shield
